reply: g part is a slow, saturating function of time at low density, rising from about 6.4 near t=0.6 to a plateau near 10 by t≈4. None of the saturating forms I tried (1−e^(−kt), t/(k+t), e^(−k/t), and others) fit exactly. The mixing term may involve a P-dependence I did not test, or a non-separable form.

best.code:
def equation(t, P, params):
    return params[0]*np.sqrt(P) + params[1]*P*np.exp(-params[2]*t) + params[3]*P**params[4] + params[5]*t**params[6]
